verdicts.reason: A: The body copy is tiny and jammed against the left edge, and it comes before the headline, so the reading order is backwards. The SOLSTICE wordmark sits below the headline, and the CTA button is crammed edge-to-edge with the two badge pills, so it doesn't stand out. At least the can stays inside its circle. B: It has all of A's flaws, and the backdrop circle has also come loose from the can and slid behind the body copy at the far left. That leaves the copy sitting on a shape and the can floating without its backdrop, which breaks the key graphic.
